description: This file defines a React component for an actions menu in a Mattermost post, including handling app bindings, plugin menu items, marketplace modal, and dropdown behavior.

classes.name: ActionMenuClass
classes.description: React component for rendering an actions menu on a Mattermost post, managing app bindings, plugin items, marketplace modal, and dropdown positioning.

methods.name: fetchBindings
methods.description: Fetches app bindings for the post's channel and team if apps are enabled and bindings are not already loaded.

methods.name: onClickAppBinding
methods.description: Handles click events on app bindings, executing associated actions and handling different response types.

methods.name: renderDivider
methods.description: Renders a divider element in the menu.

methods.name: handleDropdownOpened
methods.description: Handles the opening and positioning of the dropdown menu based on available space.
